answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 33259 Country: India Title: NIKAH & VALIMA SAME DAY Question: Pls let me know can we do Nikah and valima same day ex. nokah in Asar namaz and valima in evening after maghrib. aur can we do AQIQA in valima dawat. if we cut the sheep with the niyat of Aqiqa and can we use in valima. Answer ID: 33259 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1191/1191/M=1432) You can do nikah and walimah at the same day i.e. nikah after Asr and walimah after Maghrib. You also can do Aqiqah in the feast of walimah i.e. you can use the sheep in walimah that you would slaughter with the intention of Aqiqah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
